annotations.text:
The app as it stands, rebuilt from index.html — same tokens, same type, same spacing, real figures from 14 Sep.

These five are the thing to push on. Restyle anything here and it is a proposal you can hand back to me to put in the code.

The fold is real: each frame is a true 390x844 phone, so what falls below the tab bar is what you would have to scroll for.

DIRECTION A — LEDGER

Takes the statement idea all the way. Rules run edge to edge, no cards at all, figures in one true column with a share column beside them.

Why: it is the most honest version of what this app already is, and it reads fast once you know it.

Costs: dense and a bit severe. Nothing is friendly about it, and the running-share column is one more thing to learn.

DIRECTION B — ONE NUMBER

The opposite. The balance owns the top third, the runway sits with it as a sentence, and everything else goes quiet. One action button.

Why: you mostly open this to answer one question — how am I doing. This answers it before you read anything.

Costs: far less on screen, so more scrolling and more taps, and Bills and Stats would need the same treatment to match.
